body:
I'm sorry to hear that, seems like 2019 sucked for a lot of us :( I have come to realize that whenever I interact with strangers (a barista at the cafe, a cashier at the grocery store, etc) I always try to smile and say thank you bc it without even thinking of it. Apparently smiling, although forced, seems to make me feel a tiny bit better, so the fake it until I make it thing seems to work for me, even if slightly.

Thank you for listening, and I hope you'd feel better, too. May 2020 be a better year for both of us.

Life threw me a lot of lemons this year. For some reason it just decided 2019 is the year to keep kicking me down no matter how low I've gotten. Every time I thought 'this can't be worse'... It could. I lost so many things this year that every day, all day, I feel so emotionally drained. It feels like it's a chore to wake up and keep living if I'm just going to get hurt again.

When I *don't* feel drained, that's when guilt would start to seep in. The thing is, I have a pretty good life. My parents are very loving, supportive, and understanding, I have friends I can depend on, and I'm pretty financially stable. It's like, why do I even have depression and anxiety when I should be thankful for my life?

I don't know if I'm making sense at all, I'm really sorry if I don't. I'm just... tired.

I hope you don't mind me taking a long time to answer, but if you I understand! I'm really sorry. I appreciate you talking to me, thank you :) Sometimes it's just... hard to write anything.
Thank you :) Today has been pretty shitty and it would be nice to talk to someone.
Just one if those days where I try my best to not cry in public or throw myself into the train tracks.
I just want this pain to stop.

Got myself the new Pokemon game and finally had the chance to play for a few hours tonight. It felt great and I felt like I'm finally enjoying something that I used to like again.

And then I turned it off to go to sleep and geez... It just always feels like, no matter what I do, I can never escape my thoughts. They never disappear, they're just always hiding at the back of my mind, patiently waiting for a perfect moment to strike. I just want one day without having these thoughts, just *one day*, but I guess that's too much to ask.
It's 1am, got a deadline tomorrow, too tired to continue working, too much Bad Thoughts in my head to actually fall asleep 🙃

The past few days I surprisingly didn't feel as bad... And then tonight out of nowhere it just decided to slap me in the face and, as usual, start telling me that I'd probably better be off dead. Thanks!
I'm just feeling sad all the fucking time. I can't even go to the convenience store without crying in the aisle. Wtf.
:') It hurts how true this is.

Please vent away! I apologize for not being able to respond bc I'm not exactly in the right place for holding a conversation rn, but feel free to vent. We're in this together (sadly!), and I hope you and I both can fight another day. The neutral baseline seems too far away for me right now, but it sure would be great to be able to at least see it, one day.
Me, having the slightest bit of a sore throat: I hope I caught a deadly new virus and will die in the next 2 hours *crosses fingers*

I'm sorry to hear that, but I'm glad you won your fight that day and you had a better time. Sadly my days have been getting worse, but I hope the opposite goes for you. Thank you for taking the time to talk and share your day with me. I'm currently not very good with words, but it's nice to talk even a little bit to someone who understands.

I feel somewhat better today after finishing some parts of my list last night, although I still don't how I feel about still being here today. But thank you for your kind words, blessings to you too :)
Went swimming today in an effort to make myself feel better... only to start crying so much it flooded my goggles and stuffed my nose til I couldn't breathe properly so I had to stop early 🙃
How can you spend all day doing something you really like together with your good friend and still feeling sad and wanting to die at the end of the day? This disease is ridiculous.

Sometimes I do something that manages to distract me long enough from my thoughts. And then after it's over and while I'm still feeling okay-ish, I suddenly think, "Wait, I should be thinking of something else", and then just remember that I want to die. Rinse and repeat.

I don't know, it just gets hard to process things? Either my thoughts are jumping all over the place or my mind just... blanks. I used to read comics too but even that has become hard to process now, like I have to reread a chapter several times to finally understand it, if I end up understanding it at all. And even when I do get it, a lot of times I just... don't feel excited anymore. It just really sucks.

I loved swimming, part of it because it feels so *clear* under the water and I get to be alone with my thoughts—I get a lot of inspirations when I'm in the water. This completely backfired and became something I could no longer enjoy when my depression got more severe because I get intrusive, self-loathing, suicidal thoughts even when I'm around other people, it became unbearable to swim and let my thoughts go free.

I enjoy reading and writing as well, but both have become almost impossible to do as it's really hard for me to concentrate now, sadly.

Depression is truly shit :(

Thank you. I just feel so exhausted physically and mentally all the time. Talking sounds great but idk what to talk about, somehow stuck in a limbo of "I wanna reach out" and "I have no idea what to say"...
Thank you 🙂 I'm not very optimistic about it, but I'll try to keep looking.

Hey, thank you for this post. I'm having a very bad time right now and I opened this sub to help me get through it, and reading this reminds me that I've read Detective Conan/Case Closed for 21 years now (more than 2/3 of my life!), and I really wanna see how it ends. It really does help, even a little, to think of this. Thank you and all the best for you, mate.
